snippet.title: Threaded Dungeons Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Solo-developed, unforgiving dungeon crawler with turn-based, party-based, permadeath combat. Discover truths and treasures in a long-since-doomed world. Customize your party to fit your playstyle. Grapple with grief and mortality. Explore, despair, overcome.

Developed by a solo developer using Unity3D.

Free demo available on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559620/Threaded_Dungeons_Demo/

Main game Steam page at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461810/Threaded_Dungeons/

Follow me on BlueSky at https://bsky.app/profile/liveriver.bsky.social
